entries.descriptionOriginal:
Welcome to Crazy Diver!

🚧 Crazy Diver is currently in BETA! Expect new features, improvements, and possibly a few bugs along the way.

🤸🌊Dive into the ultimate cliff diving adventure where every jump is yours to control. Leap from incredible heights, pull off flips, twists, and freestyle tricks, then plunge into the water below.

Thanks for playing and helping us improve Crazy Diver during the Beta! ❤️
